label: <DEL> step of long (L>=7) sequences whose first token is t
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (97% of mass), when the model is about to output original token 0, and only for long sequences (L 6-9; rate and magnitude rise with L, about half the mass at L=9). Within that, it is strongly selective for the first original token being t (66% of mass, top activations all t-first). Weaker activations occur for other first tokens (k, j, 3, w) and when the second token is t or 3. Sequences starting with t with L>=7 fire about 79% of the time. Fewer than 3% of activations fall on the last 1-2 original-phase steps of L=8/9 sequences, and it never fires in the copy phase. The predicate has high precision but misses a long tail of low-magnitude delimiter activations with other first tokens (recall 0.38, mass recall 0.63).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: t, k, j, 3, w, v; least: n, f, h, 1) and the second original token (most: t, 3, v, s, b, j; least: 1, 0, n, f); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, t=7, L=9 & t=8.
